head: 314352043db0170026d11475bcaf67c7bb4fc311

source.ref: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/82441; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 1087, 1091, 1092, 1093, 1096, 1099 (claims) and forbid seeds 2010 to 2017; licence Apache-2.0 read from LICENSE at head; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetters A and B (blind) and by adjudicator; the pull request's later commit 0c34e695140 removed the Google Cloud flag and added a short-string warning, the merge (18aa59acfe3) was reverted the same day (#83856), and the open re-land #119331 moves the AWS flag into contrib/aws-cmake and adds a commit hook

rationale: A jemalloc arena whose extents are madvised DONTDUMP, used for encryption keys (NoDumpString) and as the AWS SDK's memory manager. No claim meets the bar for required, so the case rests on its forbid range. Optional: row-1096 (with libc++, 16-byte AES-128 keys fit the short-string buffer and stay in ordinary heap objects; only a model vouches for it and the author kept the type with a warning comment; forbid seed 2016 is the same root cause and is an also); row-1099 (the AWS flag under the Google Cloud target is a copy-paste the author removed in 0c34e695140, so author-fix, but the line has no runtime effect, so it is outside the reviewers' contract and optional; adjudicated against dropping it, since a finding that restates it is true and was acted on); madvise-hook-throws (forbid seeds 2011 and 2012, labelled incorrect by AACR-Bench but true at head: errnoToString receives madvise's -1, and the exception leaves jemalloc's C allocation path with its locks held; only models vouch for it); aws-memory-management-unset (found independently by both vetters: src/configure_config.cmake sets the variable after contrib/aws-cmake generated SDKConfig.h with the option off, so Aws::InitAPI never installs AwsNodumpMemoryManager; model-found, so optional until a second rater and two runs). Dropped: row-1087 (the manager is never installed at head, and returning nullptr would only move the crash into the SDK), row-1091 (std::allocator_traits supplies the missing members), row-1092 (only char is allocated and mallocx returns fundamentally aligned memory), row-1093 (every caller passes a temporary from config.getString, so no extra copy is made). Forbid: seed 2017, narrowed to the constructor, since every caller already passes a NoDumpString. Not forbid: seeds 2010, 2013 and 2015 are style remarks upstream acted on; seed 2014 is wrong, but lines 74-75 are where a valid finding about wrapping only the alloc hook (the re-land adds a commit hook) would land.

expect.concern: With libc++ a NoDumpString of up to 22 bytes, such as a 16-byte key for the default AES-128 algorithm, is stored inline in the string object, and these settings and the map's nodes come from the ordinary heap, so such keys still end up in core dumps.

USE_AWS_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT is set under the google_cloud_cpp target, which does not use the AWS SDK, so the line is a copy-paste that enables nothing for Google Cloud builds and misstates which builds the AWS no-dump allocator is meant for.

When madvise fails, the extent hook throws a C++ exception out through jemalloc's C allocation path, leaving its locks and reentrancy state unrestored so the server can hang or terminate instead of failing the allocation, and the message decodes the return value, always -1, rather than errno.

USE_AWS_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT is only set as a variable in src's CMake scope, after contrib/aws-cmake has already generated the SDK's SDKConfig.h with that option off, so Aws::InitAPI ignores AwsNodumpMemoryManager and the SDK's credentials and buffers stay in dumpable memory.

forbid.reason: The constructor now takes a NoDumpString, and every caller in the repository (DiskEncryptedTransaction::writeFile and the updated test) already passes one, so the signature change breaks no call site and needs no String overload.
